looks.name: Branch
looks.description: The leafy spirit with five glowing orbs.

looks.name: Ember
looks.description: A fox kit whose fur is layered copper-and-amber autumn leaves, tail tip glowing like an ember.

looks.name: Tock
looks.description: A round clockwork owl of polished brass and walnut, with softly glowing glass-lens eyes.

looks.name: Kite
looks.description: A cheerful paper crane folded from map paper printed with faint blue routes.

looks.name: Morel
looks.description: A small mushroom scholar with a honeycomb cap, round spectacles and a leaf scarf.

looks.name: Pebble
looks.description: A smooth river-stone golem with moss tufts and faint glowing teal runes.

looks.name: Wisp
looks.description: A fluffy cloud spirit with a small golden spark floating above its head.

looks.name: Lumen
looks.description: A lantern moth whose warm amber wings glow softly from within.

looks.name: Tide
looks.description: A teal water newt with frilly aqua gills and a gentle smile.

looks.name: Juniper
looks.description: A frosty pale-blue fawn with little evergreen antlers.

looks.name: Bolt
looks.description: A tiny tin-can robot with warm lamp eyes and a sprout on its head.

looks.name: Sorrel
looks.description: A round hedgehog whose spines are soft pine needles, with a little satchel.

looks.name: Skein
looks.description: A knitted wool creature in teal and cream, with knitting-needle antennae.

looks.name: Nib
looks.description: A glass ink bottle full of swirling blue ink, with a cork hat and a feather.
